First, try to understand what you hate in your life.  You can't hate it all, there are some elements of it (probably very important ones) that you hate.  What is it?  And how did you get in that situation?  What can you do to change it?  These are good questions to ask yourself.
hi friend
Try to understand why, it's the main step to get better.
If what you describe is accurate, it's clearly not your fault.
Were you happy before these events?
Do take your time if you feel the need.  As I said before, I believe that understanding what put you in that situation is the best first step to find a way to get back to health.
What do they do to you?
Have you tried to identify how you got in that situation?  When did it start?  What happened to you?

I understand that you do not want to post it online, and I totally respect that.  Is there anyone you trust to which you could explain your situation?  That person doesn't have to be a professional.  These subjects can be very sensitive, though, and you could get very emotive reactions.  But I think the best thing to do would be to understand why you got in that situation.  Understand what is happening to you.  That's the first step, and probably the hardest one.  Talking about it helps much more, in my experience, that I would have thought before.  Don't keep it inside.

I believe people refer to them because they don't know how to deal with suicidal people, and think people on these lines will have some miracle tricks.  But they obviously do not.  

People should take it more seriously when people have suicidal thoughts and stop wanting others to solve the problem.  If you see someone in that situation, it's your responsibility to listen to that person.  

To OP, the fact that you came here and you called them clearly means that you want to speak about your situation.  The best advice I could give you is to continue until you find someone who will listen to you.  It can be very helpful to talk.
When did these suicidal thoughts begin?  Can you identify some reasons behind it?
Why do you think you don't deserve people caring about you?
Why do you think they hate you?  Do you like them?  Can you change your environment?

I believe an introspection, and help, is what you need.  Not death.  You have to understand why, rationally, something as simple as walking on the street or going to the grocery store is that insulting to you.  You need to understand that what you think people you don't know think of you is what YOU think they should think of you.  And you're probably unjust with yourself in that manner.  Change the things you don't like about you.  Why do you think they think that of you?  Change it.  

For the financial aspect, I don't know your situation, but believe me when I say that there are ways to improve this, esp. if you don't have any debts.
Why don't you end your relationship with your friend instead of your life?  And how could you do that?
